Maya (CS): Heads up — AcroHealth bridge call tomorrow 10:00am PT. Account health = medium (trial -> paid conversation, renewal in ~45 days). They saw CPU-bound spikes on day 3. Can we lock in a short pre-call checklist for prefetch/batching/streaming and decide who owns post-call feedback capture?

Jonas (Eng): Quick plan: enable prefix prefetch for the top 10 prompts, continuous batching with target batch latency 20-30ms per token, streaming enabled with chunk fallback. Recommend warmup 50 parallel prefill requests 30m prior. Example config to share: 
```json
{
  "route": "acro-prod",
  "prefetch": {"enabled": true, "top_n": 10},
  "batching": {"mode": "continuous", "target_batch_ms": 25},
  "streaming": {"enabled": true, "chunk_size": 512, "fallback": "chunked"}
}
```

Ellen (SRE): Add SRE constraints: set request timeout to 6s, circuit-breaker threshold at 5% errors, and a canary route to a lower-capacity model for automatic fallback. Also add a Prometheus alert: `redwood_route_errors{route="acro-prod"} > 5% for 2m`.

Priya (PM): I'll own customer-facing checklist + feedback capture. Post-call we'll ask 3 short questions (latency ok? quality ok? anything blocked?) and capture NPS-ish sentiment. I'll open a GH issue and add a renewal risk tag.

Maya (CS): Can we do a synthetic warmup? Jonas — can you trigger the warmup 30m before? I want logs to confirm KV cache warms and first-token latency stabilizes.

OnboardingBot: Warmup job scheduled by Jonas: ID warmup-1748609999 — run at 2026-03-21T09:30:00Z, 50 parallel requests to `acro-prod` route. :white_check_mark:

Jonas (Eng): Note for infra: for private deployments use KV cache size 512MB and quantized model variant when possible. For hosted customers prefer L4x serving profile to keep latency stable under burst. Also recommend enabling prefix caching TTL 10m for their workload.

Ellen (SRE): I'll add the alert to the SRE playbook and create a pager policy for >10% error spikes during the call window.

Maya (CS): Action items recap — Priya opens GH issue and owns feedback capture, Ellen adds SRE alert & pager, Jonas posts final config and schedules warmup, Maya will run the pre-call checklist 30m prior and ping this thread when complete.

Priya (PM): :raised_hands: On it, I'll also add a short feedback form link to send after the call and tag the renewal tracker with sentiment.

Maya (CS): Thanks all — I'll post the final script for the 50 warmup requests and the customer-facing checklist later today.
